events.summary: Scope: five targeted workload groups from 2026-11-18 live Trivy audit. Excluded: gitea readOnlyRootFilesystem, velero/node-agent readOnlyRootFilesystem, apisix data-plane and apisix-etcd (narwhal#714), and live cluster mutations.

Inspected bundled Helm charts (gitea 12.6.0, tempo 2.2.3, apisix-ingress-controller 0.14.1, velero 12.0.3), keycloak manifests, and OCI image configs via crane: tempo chart 2.2.3 supports container-level tempo.securityContext and extraVolumeMounts; velero:v1.18.1 cnb user is UID 1002 / GID 1000; keycloak-operator starts keycloak:26.5.7 with start-optimized=false so kc.sh re-augments into /opt/keycloak/lib/quarkus.

Added containerSecurityContext runAsNonRoot/1000:1000 in 12-gitea.sh; enabled tempo.securityContext (allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, drop ALL) with a /tmp emptyDir in tempo.yaml (GitOps persistence aligned with the bootstrap 10Gi nfs-csi claim at /var/tempo, D-tempo-persist) and /tmp emptyDir parity in 08-2-monitoring.sh; added runAsGroup=65532 to apisix-ingress-controller in 08-1-networking.sh; set Velero server runAsNonRoot=true with UID 1002 / GID 1000 (omitting fsGroup so velero-plugin-for-aws UID 65532 keeps /target write access) in velero.yaml and 08-4-storage.sh; left keycloak and keycloak-operator KSV014 unset and classified as upstream.
